Definition: a heel (as protuberant); hence, a track; figuratively, the rear (of an army)
BiblicalUsage: 1) heel, rear, footprint, hinder part, hoof, rear of a troop, footstep; 1a) heel; 1b) mark of heel, footprint; 1c) hinder part, rear
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
